LESSON: THE HOLY SPIRIT

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: THE CHURCH
Topic 5.1: The Holy Spirit
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The Holy Spirit, part of THE CHURCH in Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: how they depend on the guidance of the Holy Spirit. Why should you depend on the Holy Spirit?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe the outpouring of the Holy Spirit on the day of Pentecost,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. analyse ways Christians exemplify the fruit of the Holy Spirit,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. take part in church activities to foster responsibility,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. explain the importance of participating in Church activities,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. desire to be guided by the Holy Spirit in daily life.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Holy Spirit in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the meaning of ‘the Day of Pentecost.’

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on The Holy Spirit together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: The skill of using digital technology is enhanced as learners download and watch a video about the day of

Pentecost.

• Citizenship: The skill of appropriate interaction with the community is enhanced as learners take part in church activities or

mission work.

Values:
• Love: The learners exercise the fruit of love in their day-to-day lives by living harmoniously with others.

• Responsibility: The learners participate in church activities or mission work.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Information technology: The learners use a digital device to write key points on the day of Pentecost.

• Spiritual development: The learners participate in church activities or mission work.

Link to other subjects:

• Pre-technical Studies: The learners use a digital device to watch and download a video on the day of Pentecost.

• English: The learners read Bible texts and communicate effectively during discussions or buzz sessions.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:

1. describe the outpouring of the Holy Spirit on the day of Pentecost,
2. analyse ways Christians exemplify the fruit of the Holy Spirit,
3. take part in church activities to foster responsibility,
4. explain the importance of participating in Church activities,
5. desire to be guided by the Holy Spirit in daily life.

Remember the key question: how they depend on the guidance of the Holy Spirit. Why should you depend on the Holy Spirit?
